# Google Health Fitbit MCP
Unofficial local-first MCP server that reads your own Fitbit, Pixel Watch and Google Health API data — sleep, activity, heart rate and HRV — for AI agents over local OAuth.
Repository: https://github.com/BerkKilicoglu/google-health-fitbit-mcp
Homepage: https://github.com/BerkKilicoglu/google-health-fitbit-mcp#readme
NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/google-health-fitbit-mcp
Primary command: npm exec --yes --package=google-health-fitbit-mcp -- google-health-fitbit-mcp-server checkup
MCP command: google-health-fitbit-mcp-server

- MCP registry name: io.github.BerkKilicoglu/google-health-fitbit-mcp
- Status: beta while Google Health API evolves; check official release notes because scopes and data types can change.
- Current beta ask: testers with Fitbit, Pixel Watch, Android and Google Health API access should report setup friction and data type gaps.
- For beta setup reports, run google-health-fitbit-mcp-server support --feedback --json and paste the anonymous bundle into a new GitHub issue.
- For data coverage reports, run google-health-fitbit-mcp-server coverage --json for a static plan, then google-health-fitbit-mcp-server coverage --live --json after OAuth. Live coverage is read-only and redacted.
- Start agents with google_health_connection_status and google_health_data_inventory.
- Read-only default tools: identity, profile, settings, paired devices, IRN profile, list data points, get data point, reconcile, dailyRollUp, rollUp, daily summary, weekly summary.
- OAuth env: GOOGLE_HEALTH_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_HEALTH_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_HEALTH_REDIRECT_URI.
- Tokens stay local under ~/.google-health-mcp/tokens.json and should never be printed.
- Not medical advice. Use as trend context only.
